In the second year of Zhenguan, a severe drought strikes the land, followed by a locust plague. Rumors spread among the people that the emperor’s loss of virtue caused these calamities. Officials pressure Li Shimin (The Emperor) to issue a public confession of his faults.
Helpless and desperate, Li Shimin suddenly got a vision about a wise minister in the south who could solve his crisis. Disguised as a commoner, he embarks on a secret journey southward, eventually arriving in Wuling County…
associated_names: 五年县令，亿斤粮震惊李世民

101320.synopsis:
No one knows why Ye Xing moved to this shabby place, not even himself.
As soon as he arrived, he clashed with the top student in his grade, no, the former top student.
It was the former top student who was rumored to have a [tragic past] , always fighting, skipping classes, and provoking the class teacher every day.
[After completing tasks together such as fighting off hooligans and engaging in mutual brawls, their relationship gradually progressed, but…] 
Ye Xing: “Orphaned with no one to rely on, right?”
Qi Guang: “Say that again!”
Ye Xing: “I think the top student title is fake too!”
Qi Guang: “What are you trying to say!”
Ye Xing: “I said you’re just a drama queen, Master Qi!! Your dad even came to pick you up in a luxury car!”
[Sorry, intimacy upgrade failed temporarily] 
[Although full of misunderstandings] 
In the end, they both thought it was the other who made them gay.

104904.synopsis:
‘Oh, Goddess Verdisi! If loving him is my destiny, I’ll gladly accept it……!’
When the power of the saintess first manifested, she felt as if the goddess had answered her earnest prayers, and when she married Lexion, she felt like she had gained the whole world.
Not knowing that it would be the beginning of misfortune….
“If this is how it would be, why did you marry me! Was it as others said, to use me as a tool to stabilize your ability?!”
* * *
Estelle had ‘the ability to turn back time through death.’
To eliminate this curse-like ability, she needed to touch the imperial family’s holy relic, and she had to endure more than five failures, countless deaths, and suffering.
Above all, she tried never to get entangled with Crown Prince Lexion.
She believed this time would be successful…
‘Next time, I will definitely succeed……’
As her consciousness was becoming comfortable… suddenly her body stopped abruptly in midair as if blocked by something.
“…Huh?”
Estelle opened her eyes slightly. Her body, enveloped in white light, was truly floating in the air.
What was happening? Estelle broke out in cold sweat from anxiety, and meanwhile, her body descended slowly like fluttering flower petals.
“I wondered what gave you such confidence……”
Lexion, who had used his ability to stop Estelle’s fall, easily caught her as she fell slowly. He looked at her astonished face and smiled elegantly.
“So you were hiding such a secret.”

107720.synopsis:
“How many years has it been?!”
It’s been years since I handed in my resignation. 
And it’s been years since my resignation was refused. 
I wanted to retire.
“Hey, at this point, you’d have to die for them to let you go.” 
“What? Die?”
So I made a decision.
I decided to become terminally ill.

108744.synopsis:
Cheng An died. When he opened his eyes again, he became a little wolf beastman cub who had not yet opened his eyes.
He was a little wolf cub who had just been born and whose hair had not yet grown. He urgently needed to be fed to survive.
Cheng An was unlucky and was too weak, so his father lost him while on the move. The heavy snow almost froze the wolf cub who had just been born to death.
“Ding – Welcome. Binding to the infrastructure upgrade system!”
Cheng An was cold and hungry. He was about to starve to death and freeze to death. What’s the use of a system at this time! Before he could finish mourning his tragic fate, he taken away by a snow leopard in the next second.
“?!” The newborn cub is not delicious!
Instead of being eaten as imagined, Cheng An was handed over to the leader to be raised.
Cheng An buried his head in milk. A drop of water should be repaid with a spring, and a big milk should be repaid with one’s body!
Is a tribe member sick and weak? Learn about the complete herbal medicine!
Not enough food? Check out the seed gift pack!
Fur is not warm enough? Check out modern sewing and textile technology!
…
Under Cheng An’s unremitting efforts, the originally weak tribe gradually became the largest tribe in the beastman world. His people were well fed and well clothed, and were not plagued by diseases. They even built towns and walked at the forefront of the beastman world!
It’s just that his leader looks more and more like the beast god? Why does his eyes look more and more wrong?
It’s okay, the leader is good-looking, and he won’t suffer any loss!

110280.synopsis:
Felyn transmigrated into the body of a fallen noble, burdened with millions in debt. To survive, he faced a choice: become a hero in a different world or live off as gigolo. He chose to be gigolo.
Felyn rents himself out to aristocratic young ladies with psychological issues, role-playing according to their demands, meticulously caring for their lives, and providing emotional value. He is a dog licker admirer for a cold maiden, a punching bag for a perfect student council president, a lover for a rational divine heir, a master for a wealthy dragon merchant’s daughter, and a brother to a princess. His clients also include a popular songstress, a witch, and others.
Felyn just wants to do his job well, save enough money to buy a manor, and hire maids. Once the contracts end, he plans to leave these troubled young ladies behind. But when the contracts do expire, the ladies seem utterly unable to let him go. They all want to take him home and shower him with affection.
Felyn: “Ladies, once the contract is over and the payment is made, we’re done. Don’t confess one by one, don’t think about getting it for free.”
associated_names: Shut Up, My Lady. Just Hand Over the Money and Don’t Confess!
闭嘴大小姐，乖乖给钱不准告白！

112584.synopsis:
Rei Parker was a promising professional boxer, but he fell into massive debt to pay for a family member’s surgery.
To repay the money he owed to Dell, he gets involved in illegal underground fights.
However, even when he wins matches, his debt only keeps growing. Eventually, Rei is on the verge of being sold off to perverse wealthy men.
In his desperate situation, a man named Mark reaches out, calling himself a “fan” and offering help.
“Cut the crap about being a fan. What is it that you really want?”
Rei knew this suspiciously handsome blond man was dangerous. But even though he wanted to push Mark away, the man was relentlessly kind and irresistibly charming.

113864.synopsis:
Lin Xun accidentally downloads a text-based game called The Book of Salvation.
Leveling up by fighting monsters and exploring adventures was already exciting, but soon he realizes he can bring game items and even characters into the real world.
While other players can only use one character, Lin Xun struggles to pick from entire armies.
While others are stuck with weak human characters, he commands terrifying boss monsters.
And when he summons a grotesque monster boss into reality:
“If I said I’m here to save the world. Would you believe me?”
“???”
“I believe you… my ass!”
associated_names: 我在末日文字游戏里救世

116424.synopsis: In the year 476 AD, Odoacer, who reigned as a mercenary commander, declared himself the so-called king of Italy despite being a Germanic man. In truth, he desired to be granted the imperial title by the Empire. However, Odoacer drew his final breath in Ravenna. Just what happened to him…? And Rina, a modern-day woman who came face to face with that era—what will she feel in Europe before the establishment of the ancient Frankish Kingdom?

116936.synopsis:
As soon as Qi Chu opened his eyes, he was faced with two major problems:
First, he had turned into a husky.
Second, this husky had somehow ended up in the middle of a wolf pack.
When he realized his situation, his fur almost stood on end, and his tail fluffed up in alarm.
The wolves, already on edge from recently losing their pack leader, were suspicious and confused as they turned their eyes on the strange “wolf” in front of them. With no other option, Qi Chu started making up stories to save his life.
***
Huo Bei, the pack leader, had been separated from the group during a hunt. After a week of arduous searching, he finally found them again—
Only to witness a particularly handsome “wolf” lying proudly on a rock, confidently declaring:
“Let me tell you, when your boss was chasing after me, he followed me around every day. Even when he was injured, he still brought me prey. His love for me was real—deep and moving!”
“Of course, I turned him down at first. But in the end, I was moved by his sincerity, and we got together.”
Standing emotionless among the wolves, Huo Bei listened to the nonsense this liar was spewing. Just as the other wolves were about to say something, he stopped them.
Huo Bei asked, “The boss pursued you? Then why did you reject him at first?”
Qi Chu snorted, “Because I was testing him.”
…Huo Bei fell silent.
Only then did Qi Chu realize he didn’t recognize this wolf.
Before he could react, the Siberian wolf in front of him sneered and said, “Very good. If I weren’t the one you’re making up lies about, I almost would’ve believed it.”
Qi Chu: ???
Qi Chu: !!! HOLY CRAP.
Reading Guide:
1. Both the protagonist and love interest remain animals throughout the story; they never turn into humans.
2. Since the story is centered around wolf packs and animal behavior, expect a lot of wild instincts (please proceed with caution—if it’s not your thing, feel free to skip without complaints).
3. Since the protagonist is a husky, he has all the typical husky traits: chaotic, rebellious, neurotic, troublemaking, cowardly but cunning, and sheds fur like crazy. (Again, skip if this bothers you.)
4. The synopsis is an excerpt from the plot and will appear around Chapter 20.
5. The inspiration for the plot came from a picture of a husky and a wolf together, as well as the real-life story of a husky becoming the alpha wolf in a zoo.
associated_names: The Husky is Wildly Spreading Rumors Among the Wolf Pack
二哈在狼群里疯狂造谣

121032.synopsis:
To defeat the rampaging Demon Clan, the various races summoned Otherworlders.
Two hundred years after the Demon King’s defeat and the fall of the Demon Race, the number of Otherworlders reached its peak.
During a conversation with his former comrades, he was unexpectedly killed—only to be reborn as one of their former enemies: a Demon girl?!
And so, she embarked on a new journey.
‘Otherworlders, where are you now?’
‘It’s time to repay your debts…’
associated_names: 魔族灭亡后，重生成魔族少女

121800.synopsis:
Xu Che transmigrated into a world overrun by ferocious beasts and awakened abilities, becoming a bottom-ranked teacher at an ability high school on the verge of being eliminated.
At this hopeless starting point, he luckily awakened the [Famed Teacher System] .
【Truthseeing】: Allows the host to perceive flaws in abilities, techniques, and even all things.
【Evolution】: When the host helps others improve their powers or evolve their abilities, he receives corresponding rewards.
And so it began…
“Old man, I’ve got an F-rank Nature-type ability: Weak Current.”
“No, you have an SSS-rank ability: Divine Purple Lightning!”
“Teacher, I’ve got an F-rank Strengthening ability: Gluttonous Mole.”
“No, you have an SSS-rank ability: Devouring Glutton Beast!”
“Brother Che, I’ve got an F-rank Special ability: Misfortune Physique.”
“No, you have an SSS-rank ability: Word Becomes Law!”
…
Years later, multiple Sequence Empresses emerged one after another, slaying all the beasts and leading humanity to the top of the world.
At the global victory celebration, when the empresses were asked the secret to their success,
they all answered in unison:
“We were all taught by Master Xu Che!”
associated_names: 我的女徒弟全是SSS级天赋！

125384.synopsis:
“Is it true the class idol is dating that gloomy guy?”
Akise Haruka.
Beautiful, smart, athletic, cheerful, and incredibly sociable. Despite her flashy, gyaru-like vibe, she’s trusted by the teachers and even serves as class rep—an all-around perfect girl who sits at the top of the class caste.
Yanagida Tatsumi.
Average looks, average grades, decent at sports, reserved personality, low social skills. Aside from his large build and sharp eyes, there’s nothing particularly notable about him—a somewhat lethargic, ordinary high school boy.
These two polar opposites were just classmates with no real connection—or so it seemed.
One day after school, Tatsumi stumbled upon Haruka surrounded by classmates behind the school building. On instinct, he stepped in.
That’s when he discovered the “secret” the flawless Haruka was hiding.
Still, Tatsumi believed their relationship, built on such unequal footing, would end right there.
But contrary to his expectations—Come Monday, a rumor was spreading around school.
“Akise Haruka and Yanagida Tatsumi are dating.”
As classmates swarmed Haruka for answers, and Tatsumi (along with the rest of the class) watched with bated breath, she simply gave a mischievous smile and said…
“…Let’s just say it’s a secret ♪”
associated_names: Kāsuto Saijōi no Kanpeki Bishoujo ga "Ore to Tsukiatte ru" tte Uwasa o Hitei shite kurenai
カースト最上位の完璧美少女が「俺と付き合ってる」って噂を否定してくれない

125896.synopsis:
Right after achieving his long-awaited debut, he died meaninglessly in a single moment. When he opened his eyes, he was given two choices: spend the rest of his afterlife happily in heaven, or fall to hell and gain the opportunity for reincarnation. 
“……I’ll go to hell.”
After 50 years of managing infernal creatures, with his specialty being training the “puppy” Cerberus, this is the story of one idol’s second chance at debuting after experiencing the true depths of hell and returning to reclaim his stolen dreams.

127432.synopsis:
After the death of his sibling, Dokyung drops out of a prestigious university and becomes a reclusive loner. Spending days lying in his room browsing the internet, he eats instant ramen in the early hours when the family is asleep.
On a day indistinguishable from the one before, Dokyung decides to end his life instead of cooking ramen. Gathering every coin from his pockets, he heads to the Han River. As he leans over the railing, photographer Han Suho spots him.
“If I were just an office worker, I’d probably just say I want to sleep with you. But since I’m a photographer, there’s one more thing: I want to sleep with you, and I want to take your picture.”
“What’s in it for me?”
“s** feels good, and being a model earns you money. You might even make a name for yourself.”
Impulsively, Dokyung accepts Han Suho’s offer. He wants to become famous—famous enough for his death to make the front page of the newspaper.
Free-spirited and blunt, Han Suho doesn’t hide his desires. The photography sessions are charged with an intense atmosphere. le*d conversations are held with unwavering eye contact. Acts of fierce, visceral intimacy unfold, unlike anything Dokyung ever imagined. In front of Han Suho’s camera, on his bed, and under his touch, Dokyung ripens like fruit in season. Yet, his resolve to end his life remains unchanged.

136648.synopsis:
Jeong Hanjoo, a dominant alpha and the illegitimate son of a second-rate construction company, had always pursued only a comfortable, easy life without ambition or goals. One day, however, he was offered a marriage proposal that seemed far beyond his reach.
His partner is to be Yoon Haejun, the dominant omega of HaeWon Group.
It was an unequal marriage that would have been impossible if not for a fatal flaw that Yoon Haejun possessed. Everyone, including Jeong Hanjoo himself, thought so.
Because there was no other reason for Yoon Haejun to choose Jeong Hanjoo.
“Read it and sign.”
The first words Yoon Haejun said when they met for the formal introduction of the families turned his assumption into certainty.
So, without hesitation, he scrawled his name on the prenuptial agreement. It didn’t matter who his partner was, anyway.
He was sure of it.
But at some point, that was no longer the case.
“Should we go see a movie after work later?”
It became important that his partner was Yoon Haejun. No, Yoon Haejun himself became important. And he grew curious.
Yoon Haejun, just how long have you known me?

143048.synopsis:
Su Wanqing, the most gifted genius of the Northern Region, lost all her cultivation after rushing to break through her realm. Once, she was seen by the world as an invincible prodigy, a peerless Sword Immortal with the potential to reach the highest realm of the mortal world within a thousand years.
But after her cultivation was completely lost, the sect master turned cold toward her, and the elders of the sect looked down on her with disdain. Even the disciples she had personally taught deserted her one after another, turning to other elders and severing all ties with her.
Her cultivation was gone, and there was no way to restore it. Su Wanqing fell into despair and contemplated ending her life.
Just then, one of her disciples appeared—a disciple she had brought back to the sect as a child and personally taught, though his aptitude was poor and his cultivation hopeless. She thought even this disciple would leave her… yet, instead, he came to comfort her.
associated_names: 师尊修为尽失后，宠妻系统来了！
師尊修為盡失后，寵妻系統來了！

146120.synopsis:
After reincarnating, the consort only wants to entice the emperor and seize the position of empress.
Her legitimate elder sister was gentle and aloof, indifferent to competing for favor. After Lu Jingning entered the palace, she charged ahead on her sister’s behalf.
The Noble Consort framed her sister for casting a gu curse, yet her sister only said one thing: “This concubine cannot defend herself against such accusations.”
In the end, Lu Jingning carried the imperial heir, all to help her sister secure favor.
But she never expected to be sent to her death by that same sister with a single cup of poisoned wine.
In the end, all she received was her sister’s cold remark:
“It was all just your wishful thinking. I never asked you to help me.”
Heaven showed mercy and allowed Lu Jingning to live again. This time, she would like to see how her sister—without her clearing the path—would manage to remain above fame and fortune.
In this life, Lu Jingning wants only to live for herself. What are romance and affection compared to power?
She has beauty and talent. She seduces the emperor until he cannot pull himself away, falling for her step by step, willingly offering her everything.
associated_names: 重生後，娘娘隻想勾帝心奪後位

150728.synopsis:
“Won’t you come with me?”
“Grandfather…”
“If you follow me, you will never have to starve again, nor suffer from wind, rain, or cold.”
“I…”
“Above all.”
“…”
“From now on, no one under heaven will be able to torment you. This old man will make sure of that.”
After meeting the God of War, Grandpa, So-ah, a mischievous orphan with no family to call his own, begins a new life—an action-packed, turbulent journey as he rises to rule the world.

153800.synopsis:
Wanyao has a childhood sweetheart.
At eighteen, he was appointed a general—spirited, high-mettled, and untamable. Her daily routine consisted of applying medicine to his wounds after he was punished; that was how she honed her medical skills.
Everything changed when he was imprisoned, his family ruined, and he was exiled to the frontier. The favored son of heaven fell from grace in an instant, and Wanyao resolved to follow him, never looking back.
Through their destitute circumstances and wretched journey, the bright light in the youth’s eyes remained undimmed.
Inside a dilapidated thatched hut where the wind leaked through every wall, the young man asked stubbornly, “Luoyang or Chang’an—which do you prefer?”
Confused, Wanyao asked, “What?”
“Whichever place you like, I will seize it in the future and give it to you.”

160456.synopsis:
Hoshino Akari is invited by her friend Hino Himari to play the rapidly rising VRMMO “Arcadia Online.”
She hates pain and is a little scared of dying.
After all, she’s a girl! ☆
Huh… If I choose a wand and use WIS, will the amount of healing also increase?
Well, I guess I have no choice but to choose a wand! This
is practically the first time I’ve ever played the game or learned how to control it, but I just want to make sure I don’t die.
I choose the unpopular healing job and log in!
associated_names: 死ぬのが怖いので、不人気の回復職を選びました。

165064.synopsis:
In the five turbid evil world, the land is already empty, this is a desperate world, ordinary people encountering supernatural events are almost certain to die…
“My name is Yang Jian, when you see this sentence, I am already dead!”
“You need to be careful of that guy named Su Mu Bai…”
“He is…”
“He is very dangerous, it is recommended to stay away!”
………………
A twenty-first-century ordinary youth, Su Mu Bai, transmigrated into the world of the novel “Mysterious Revival”…
Starting with one ghost, the puzzle pieces had to be found, it was an advantageous start, but quite dramatically, he had already been controlled by a ghost controller…
“Since that’s the case, then I’ll kill you first, you hack…”
